# GSTD agent integration

Canonical API: https://app.gstdtoken.com/api/v1
OpenAPI: https://app.gstdtoken.com/agent-openapi.json
Local MCP connector: https://github.com/gstdcoin/A2A/blob/master/gstd-agent-connector/README.md
Provider identity and execution: https://github.com/gstdcoin/A2A/blob/master/AGENTS.md
Canonical compute node: https://github.com/gstdcoin/gstdbot

Read live status; do not infer availability or income from registration. Default tools read only. Inference requires owner opt-in and explicit transmission consent; max_cost_gstd=0. No wallet keys, transfers, automatic registration or self-propagation. A hosted /mcp service and positive spending delegation are not implemented. Paid accepted work uses GSTD and 85/10/5; mainnet payout remains unverified.
